Status comes from AstrBot adapters. Running means the adapter started; verify callbacks and message delivery with a real message. Unavailable observations remain unknown.

1. Start AstrBot and open QQ Official Bot from Home. An unbound platform displays the authorization QR code immediately. Scan with QQ and follow the official page; no additional AstrBot password is needed.

2. Authorization is saved and connected automatically; no additional save action is needed. Existing connections support rebinding, enable/disable and local removal. Removal does not delete the bot on the official platform. Manual AppID and Secret entry is available. New connections use WebSocket without a public callback; existing Webhook settings are retained.

3. Configure a model in AstrBot, confirm test members or publication scope on QQ Open Platform, and send a message from an authorized QQ account. Official bots differ from personal QQ accounts.

1. Confirm official ClawBot is available in WeChat. Start AstrBot and open WeChat Official Bot from Home. An unbound platform displays its QR code immediately; no additional AstrBot password is needed.

2. Scan in WeChat and authorize the ClawBot bot. Authorization is saved and connected automatically; no additional save action is needed. Existing connections support rebinding, enable/disable and local removal. Removal does not delete the bot on the official platform. Upstream currently requires Android WeChat 8.0.69 or newer.

3. Configure a model in AstrBot and send a message through ClawBot.

This uses the official WeChat ClawBot (openclaw-weixin / iLink) bot API and bot tokens, without hosting a WeChat client login session. Unofficial personal-account hosting or protocol logins may lead to account restrictions; they are separate from this entry. ClawBot use remains subject to WeChat platform rules.
